title: Computer Fundamentals and Applications
description: Covers basic computer fundamentals, software, hardware, operating systems, DBMS, networks, and recent trends. Aims to help students convert theoretical concepts into practical skills using application packages.

units.title: Introduction to Computer System
topics: Definition, anatomy, types, history and generations of computers
Applications of computers in various fields

units.title: Computer Software
topics: Types of software, operating system functions

units.title: Database Management System
topics: Introduction to data, database, DBMS architecture
Models, SQL/NoSQL, data warehousing, data mining

units.title: Data Communication and Computer Network
topics: OSI model, protocols, World Wide Web

units.title: Computer Security
topics: Cryptography, digital signatures, firewalls, security policies
